content.text: {"id": "mm4836a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "7239 (90.5%) were vaccinated, 260 (3.3%) were not vaccinated because of contraindications"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The coverage rate measured during this week was 63%."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In four of the five camps with complete tent-by-tent surveys, coverage rates were greater than or equal to 89%."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The coverage rate measured during this week was 63%."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "7239 (90.5%) were vaccinated, 260 (3.3%) were not vaccinated because of contraindications"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In four of the five camps with complete tent-by-tent surveys, coverage rates were greater than or equal to 89%."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccine coverage rates decreased during the weeks following the first campaign"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a tent-by-tent survey was conducted on the last day of the campaign to evaluate vaccination coverage"}]}, {"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Volunteers and staff visited each tent to count all children aged less than 48 months living in that tent"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccine coverage rates decreased during the weeks following the first campaign"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The numerator of the overall coverage rate for each camp was the number of children aged less than 48 months vaccinated in camp"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The denominator was the total number of children aged less than 48 months in a particular camp"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In five of the seven refugee camps, a tent-by-tent survey was conducted on the last day of the campaign to evaluate vaccination coverage."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
